improvements.title: Largest Contentful Paint
improvements.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)

improvements.title: Largest Contentful Paint element
improvements.description: This is the largest contentful element painted within the viewport. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint element](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)

improvements.title: Elements use prohibited ARIA attributes
improvements.description: Using ARIA attributes in roles where they are prohibited can mean that important information is not communicated to users of assistive technologies. [Learn more about prohibited ARIA roles](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-prohibited-attr).

improvements.title: `[aria-*]` attributes do not have valid values
improvements.description: Assistive technologies, like screen readers, can't interpret ARIA attributes with invalid values. [Learn more about valid values for ARIA attributes](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-valid-attr-value).

improvements.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.
improvements.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. [Learn how to provide sufficient color contrast](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/color-contrast).

improvements.title: Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order
improvements.description: Properly ordered headings that do not skip levels convey the semantic structure of the page, making it easier to navigate and understand when using assistive technologies. [Learn more about heading order](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/heading-order).

improvements.title: Serve images in next-gen formats
improvements.description: Image formats like WebP and AVIF often provide better compression than PNG or JPEG, which means faster downloads and less data consumption. [Learn more about modern image formats](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/uses-webp-images/).

improvements.title: Improve image delivery
improvements.description: Reducing the download time of images can improve the perceived load time of the page and LCP. [Learn more about optimizing image size](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/uses-optimized-images/)

improvements.title: LCP request discovery
improvements.description: Optimize LCP by making the LCP image [discoverable](https://web.dev/articles/optimize-lcp#1_eliminate_resource_load_delay) from the HTML immediately, and [avoiding lazy-loading](https://web.dev/articles/lcp-lazy-loading)

improvements.title: Network dependency tree
improvements.description: [Avoid chaining critical requests](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/critical-request-chains) by reducing the length of chains, reducing the download size of resources, or deferring the download of unnecessary resources to improve page load.

improvements.title: Time to Interactive
improvements.description: Time to Interactive is the amount of time it takes for the page to become fully interactive. [Learn more about the Time to Interactive metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/interactive/).

improvements.title: Avoid enormous network payloads
improvements.description: Large network payloads cost users real money and are highly correlated with long load times. [Learn how to reduce payload sizes](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/total-byte-weight/).

improvements.title: Eliminate render-blocking resources
improvements.description: Resources are blocking the first paint of your page. Consider delivering critical JS/CSS inline and deferring all non-critical JS/styles. [Learn how to eliminate render-blocking resources](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/render-blocking-resources/).

improvements.title: Reduce unused JavaScript
improvements.description: Reduce unused JavaScript and defer loading scripts until they are required to decrease bytes consumed by network activity. [Learn how to reduce unused JavaScript](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/unused-javascript/).

improvements.title: Render blocking requests
improvements.description: Requests are blocking the page's initial render, which may delay LCP. [Deferring or inlining](https://web.dev/learn/performance/understanding-the-critical-path#render-blocking_resources) can move these network requests out of the critical path.

improvements.title: First Contentful Paint
improvements.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).

improvements.title: Speed Index
improvements.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated. [Learn more about the Speed Index metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/speed-index/).
